deviceAueCountReports.description: The list of reports sorted by auto update expiration date in ascending order.

GoogleChromeManagementV1DiskInfo.description: Status of the single storage device.

type.description: Output only. Disk type: eMMC / NVMe / ATA / SCSI.

ioTimeThisSession.description: Output only. Counts the time the disk and queue were busy, so unlike the fields above, parallel requests are not counted multiple times.

bytesReadThisSession.description: Output only. Number of bytes read since last boot.

bytesWrittenThisSession.description: Output only. Number of bytes written since last boot.

readTimeThisSession.description: Output only. Time spent reading from disk since last boot.

writeTimeThisSession.description: Output only. Time spent writing to disk since last boot.

discardTimeThisSession.description: Output only. Time spent discarding since last boot. Discarding is writing to clear blocks which are no longer in use. Supported on kernels 4.18+.

keyTrustLevel.description: Output only. Trust level of the public key.
enumDescriptions: Represents an unspecified public key trust level.

keyType.description: Output only. Type of the public key.
enumDescriptions: Represents an unspecified public key type.

publicKey.description: Output only. Value of the public key.

keyRotationTime.description: Output only. Latest rotation timestamp of the public key rotation.

GoogleChromeManagementVersionsV1Attestat.description: Information of public key associated with a Chrome browser profile.

reportTime.description: Output only. Time at which the graphics data was reported.

displays.description: Output only. Information about the displays for the device.

GoogleChromeManagementV1GraphicsStatusRe.description: Information of the graphics subsystem. * This field is telemetry information and this will change over time as the device is utilized. * Data for this field is controlled via policy: [ReportDeviceGraphicsInfo](https://chromeenterprise.google/policies/#ReportDeviceGraphicsInfo) * Data Collection Frequency: 3 hours. * Default Data Reporting Frequency: 3 hours - Policy Controlled: Yes * Cache: If the device is offline, the collected data is stored locally, and will be reported when the device is next online: No * Reported for affiliated users only: N/A * Granular permission needed: TELEMETRY_API_GRAPHICS_REPORT

GoogleChromeManagementV1TelemetryNetwork.description: `TelemetryNetworkSignalStrengthEvent` is triggered on WiFi signal strength events. * Granular permission needed: TELEMETRY_API_NETWORK_REPORT

model.description: Public model name of the devices.

aueMonth.description: Enum value of month corresponding to the auto update expiration date in UTC time zone. If the device is already expired, this field is empty.

count.description: Count of devices of this model.

aueYear.description: Int value of year corresponding to the Auto Update Expiration date in UTC time zone. If the device is already expired, this field is empty.

expired.description: Boolean value for whether or not the device has already expired.

GoogleChromeManagementV1DeviceAueCountRe.description: Report for CountChromeDevicesPerAueDateResponse, contains the count of devices of a specific model and auto update expiration range.

extensionName.description: Output only. Name of the extension.

policyData.description: Output only. Information of the policies applied on the extension.

extensionId.description: Output only. ID of the extension.

GoogleChromeManagementVersionsV1Reportin.description: Information of the policies applied on an extension.

reportTime.description: Output only. Timestamp of when the diagnostics were collected.

httpsLatencyData.description: Output only. HTTPS latency test data.

GoogleChromeManagementV1NetworkDiagnosti.description: Network testing results to determine the health of the device's network connection, for example whether the HTTPS latency is high or normal. * Granular permission needed: TELEMETRY_API_NETWORK_REPORT
